data.body: Investigation result: Fix complexity COMPLEX. The bug spans multiple subsystems (skill files, sub-agent prompts, ticket-create CLI, potential pre-event hook) with at least 4 distinct root causes (missing --parent in skill call sites, sub-agent context payloads lacking parent ID, silently-swallowed ticket link failures, no creation-time validator). Per fix-bug Phase D Step 2, single-track fix is inappropriate — this requires /dso:brainstorm for epic-level scoping and design decisions (e.g., make --parent mandatory for story/task ticket types? add --standalone opt-out? add pre-event validator hook?). Leaving open. Recommend invoking /dso:brainstorm 7883-a502-e318-403e in a separate session to scope an epic.
